components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered. Optional; defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true

## Summary

I implemented the household-duplicate rule for `POST /api/owners`: an owner is rejected with **409** when another owner has the same last name and address (compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace), unless the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`.

Following the existing OfficeFloor pipeline conventions (mirroring the `RequireUniqueTelephone` rule), I added:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added a write-only `sharesHousehold` boolean to the `OwnerFields` schema so the generated `OwnerFieldsDto` binds it from the request body without leaking into responses. It's a request-only directive, not stored (the `Owner` entity is unchanged, and MapStruct simply leaves it unmapped).

2. **`OwnerHouseholds`** (helper) — encapsulates household identity: a `key(lastName, address)` that trims, collapses internal whitespace, and lower-cases each field, joined by a separator so `"a b"+"c"` can't collide with `"a"+"b c"`. This mirrors the `OwnerTelephones` canonicalization helper.

3. **`RequireUniqueHousehold`** (pipeline step) — short-circuits when `sharesHousehold` is true; otherwise scans existing owners and throws `DuplicateHouseholdException` on a matching household key. Wired into `owners.POST.yml` between `requireUniqueTelephone` and `build`, under the transaction governance like its neighbours.

4. **`DuplicateHouseholdException`** (checked) + **`DuplicateHouseholdExceptionHandler`** + escalation YAML — responds 409 via `ProblemDetail`, matching the `DuplicateTelephoneException` pattern exactly.

Each piece has a single responsibility (normalization, the rule, the error, the HTTP mapping) and reuses the established helpers/handlers rather than duplicating them.

One incidental note: while editing, the `OwnerHouseholds` file initially got written with a stray NUL byte as the field separator; I caught it via a byte inspection and rewrote it to use an explicit `"\n"` escape.
